identity.defect: Register submit gate requires 12+ byte passwords while the server accepts 8+, blocking server-valid 8-11 byte passwords

findings.dispositionReason: MINIMUM_PASSWORD_BYTES=12 is the Desktop's own password-entry policy for every user-chosen password, not a contract mirror: FirstLoginPasswordChangeForm (the product's other self-chosen-password surface, issue #101) applies the identical isPasswordByteLengthValid gate with the same 12+ inline recommendation. The register form matching that established UX policy is intended consistency; the server's 8-byte floor is the API minimum, and no acceptance criterion of #121 requires the Desktop to expose it. The 12..72 gate also keeps every Desktop-set credential inside bcrypt capacity.
evidence: apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/authentication/policy/password.ts: MINIMUM_PASSWORD_BYTES = 12, MAXIMUM_PASSWORD_BYTES = 72
FirstLoginPasswordChangeForm (pre-existing, issue #101): canSubmit = ... isNewPasswordValid(isPasswordByteLengthValid) — same 12-byte gate for a user-chosen password
AuthenticationErrorMessage/PasswordPolicyFeedback render the 12+ recommendation in both surfaces
